final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias generation ----
* ibias pin voltage = vnc (NMOS cascode gate) = Vgs(MB0) + Iref*RN
RN    ibias nb 15000
MB0   nb    nb  vss vss nfet W=2 L=1
* PMOS bias branch: 10uA copy -> diode MPB (vbp) -> RP -> vpc
MB1   vpc   nb  vss vss nfet W=2 L=1
RP    vbp   vpc 25000
MPB   vbp   vbp vdd vdd pfet W=3 L=0.5
* ---- input pair + tail ----
MT    tail  nb   vss  vss nfet W=60 L=1
MN1   fa    vinp tail vss nfet W=20 L=0.2
MN2   fb    vinn tail vss nfet W=20 L=0.2
* ---- PMOS current sources (fold) ----
MP1   fa    vbp vdd vdd pfet W=70 L=0.5
MP2   fb    vbp vdd vdd pfet W=70 L=0.5
* ---- PMOS cascodes ----
MPC1  ca    vpc fa  vdd pfet W=30 L=0.25
MPC2  vout  vpc fb  vdd pfet W=30 L=0.25
* ---- NMOS wide-swing cascode mirror (diff -> single-ended) ----
MNC3  ca    ibias xa  vss nfet W=20 L=0.2
MNC4  vout  ibias xb  vss nfet W=20 L=0.2
MN3   xa    ca    vss vss nfet W=15 L=0.5
MN4   xb    ca    vss vss nfet W=15 L=0.5
.ends dut
